description: Clean tabular data with CleanChart's fix engine and get the cleaned rows back plus a change log. Options (all optional booleans unless noted): remove_duplicates, remove_empty_rows, remove_empty_columns, trim_whitespace, replace_invalid_values (turn N/A/-/? into null), nullify_missing, convert_types, missing_strategy ('fill_smart' fills gaps with column mean or 'Unknown'), date_standardization with date_columns (string[], converts recognized date formats to YYYY-MM-DD), strip_numeric_formatting with format_columns (string[]), strip_coded_values with coded_columns (string[]).

data.description: Tabular data as an array of row objects, e.g. [{"Month":"2026-01","Sales":120}, ...]. All rows should share the same keys (column names).

name: apply_data_fixes
title: Apply data fixes
